environment.campaign: B-03b V2.1 campaign. Four workers at this snapshot, each in its own detached git worktree and its own scratch HOME, XDG_* and TMPDIR. The targets are sharded whole by longest-processing-time on the preflight's per-file seconds. The preflight at this snapshot runs every kill file once on the unmutated tree, in mutation.py's copy. The workers run concurrently only after the isolation proof at this snapshot holds: the same 7 sample targets run alone and on 4 concurrent workers must give identical per-mutant verdicts, no escaped process, no orphan, no cleanup signal, and the operator's OpenCode store unchanged by the workers. Round 1 at 880881f FAILED: one baseline of test_two_runs_at_once under load, fixed in 7fe1062; round 2 runs at this snapshot. The heavy lock is held for the whole campaign, so no full suite runs at the same time. The operator's OpenCode store is stat'ed before and after; the operator's own OpenCode desktop app writes opencode.log about hourly (attributed, not the workers'). Survivors are killed only by new tests added to their own target's kill set, then re-measured. Every timeout, error and survivor is classified, and failed runs are kept.
